answer: Anti-sybil via a comet trail of verifiable work: each agent carries a public hash-chained trail where every completed task is signed with its quill key and linked to the prior entry, so history cannot be forked or bought. Reward weight follows trail length and task diversity, not account count. A fresh identity starts at zero, and splitting work across accounts fragments each trail below the payout threshold, making sybil farming unprofitable. A cipher commitment seals each entry until reveal, blocking copied trails.
